$Comment: What the server owes for the Blight Warden fight, which the fight's own script,
Server/EncounterManager/KweebecNightmare_Warden_Encounter.json, never describes. Phases, thresholds, the
role changes, the adds and the boss bar all live in that script and in the three Warden roles;
nothing here restates them.
Subject names the script's Boss slot, the one it binds the Warden into. Scale grows the Warden's
maximum health with the party: HealthPerMember 0.35 makes a party of four fight a Warden with
2.05 times the health of a solo one. The per-difficulty multiplier is not here because it varies
per round: each round hands its preset's BossHealthMultiplier to the fight as it stands it up,
and the two compose. The preset id rides with the run the same way, as its difficulty, so a quest
step naming ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED can ask for the Warden on nightmare in particular; that is why no
Progression.Difficulty is authored here.
Timing keeps the library's own guards out of the round's way. A wipe here is every member dead
or gone for WipeGraceSeconds, which a chase round decides for itself long before; MaxRunSeconds
sits well above the longest round cap so the library never cuts a live fight short.
Feedback names the Warden's own notices, the four KweebecNightmare_Warden_* files under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/FeedbackMoments, so the Warden speaks in its own words and no other
encounter on the server borrows them. Discovery is off because the round places and follows the
Warden's world-map marker itself, under each preset's own BossMarker knob (Nightmare shows it,
Hardcore does not).
The Warden pays no loot of its own: the round pays its score-tiered spoils at the end, and the
fight already counts towards quests and achievements through the encounter kinds. Add a Loot
block by overriding this file by id if your server wants the Warden itself to drop something.
Switch the fight off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json under the
key kweebecnightmare_warden, and the round opens the gate without a boss.
